## You Work Hard. So Why Does Your Bank Balance Never Move?

Most people in Nigeria don't have a saving problem. They have a staying-committed problem.

You get paid. There are obligations. The days move fast. By the end of the month, there's nothing left to set aside — not because you didn't earn enough, but because the money was too easy to spend before you could save it.

- You transfer money to yourself "to save" and spend it before the week ends
- Traditional bank savings accounts earn almost nothing in interest
- It takes iron willpower to save consistently when life keeps happening
- You open savings apps and stop using them after two weeks

The issue is not discipline. The issue is that no one has made it automatic, accountable, and actually rewarding. Until now.

---

<!-- SOLUTION SECTION                             -->
<!-- ============================================ -->

## The Online Savings App Built for How Nigerians Actually Live

PiggyVest combines automated savings, goal-setting tools, and real investment options in one platform — so your online savings app Nigeria experience goes from frustrating to effortless. You set the rules once. It works while you don't think about it.

### Save Automatically Without Thinking About It
PiggyVest's Piggybank product deducts your chosen amount on a schedule you control — daily, weekly, or monthly. The money moves before you can spend it, and you earn interest on every naira you set aside.

### Lock Your Savings and Earn More
Safelock lets you put money away for a fixed period at a higher interest rate. You cannot access it until the date you choose — which means no accidental withdrawals, and a guaranteed payout with real returns.

### Save in Dollars and Protect Your Purchasing Power
With Flex Dollar, you can save in USD directly from Nigeria. Your naira doesn't have to lose value while it sits. Dollar savings have never been this accessible for everyday Nigerians.

## PiggyVest vs Saving With Your Regular Bank

| Feature / Outcome | PiggyVest | Traditional Bank Savings |
|---|---|---|
| Automated savings deductions | ✅ Automatic on your schedule | ❌ Manual transfer only |
| Higher interest rates | ✅ Up to 13% per annum | ❌ 1–4% per annum average |
| Goal-based savings pockets | ✅ Multiple named goals | ❌ Single account |
| Dollar savings option | ✅ Flex Dollar available | ❌ FX accounts are complex |
| Mobile-first experience | ✅ App built for smartphones | ⚠️ Mobile banking varies |
| Lock savings to avoid spending | ✅ Safelock feature | ❌ Not available |
| Branch visits required | ❌ Never | ✅ Sometimes still required |

_One area where banks win: NDIC deposit insurance coverage. PiggyVest is regulated by the CBN and uses bank-level security, but traditional savings accounts under ₦500,000 carry NDIC insurance._

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is PiggyVest?**  
A: PiggyVest is a Nigerian online savings and investment app used by over 6 million people. It lets you automate savings, lock funds for higher interest, set savings goals, and save in both naira and dollars — all from your phone.

**Q: How does saving work on PiggyVest?**  
A: You fund your PiggyVest wallet and choose a savings product — Piggybank deducts automatically on a schedule, Safelock locks your money for a fixed period, and Target lets you save toward a named goal. You earn interest on all savings.

**Q: Can I withdraw my money at any time?**  
A: It depends on the product. Flex Naira and Flex Dollar allow withdrawals anytime. Piggybank has a quarterly withdrawal window. Safelock is locked until your chosen maturity date. Each product clearly states its withdrawal terms before you commit.

**Q: Is PiggyVest safe and regulated?**  
A: Yes. PiggyVest is regulated by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN). It uses 256-bit SSL encryption — the same standard used by major banks — and has processed over ₦1 trillion in user funds since launch.

**Q: Does PiggyVest charge fees?**  
A: Creating an account and saving are free. There is a small fee on early withdrawals from certain products. There are no monthly maintenance fees and no minimum balance requirement to open an account.

**Q: Who is PiggyVest for?**  
A: PiggyVest is for any Nigerian who earns money and wants to keep more of it — whether you're a salaried employee, freelancer, student, or business owner. If you find it hard to save consistently, PiggyVest is designed specifically for you.
